summary: The login and registration mode tabs are reachable and operable with a hardware keyboard, and selection is exposed through tab semantics.

checks.name: Authentication mode tabs keyboard regression
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/auth_screen_test.dart --reporter compact
checks.observation: All 13 auth screen widget tests passed. The new regression sends Tab twice and Space, then verifies Registration is selected in semantics and no framework exception occurred.

limitations: Physical keyboard and platform screen-reader acceptance was not performed on macOS, Windows or Android.
remaining: Verify keyboard and screen-reader behavior on each target OS; matched authentication screenshots remain open.
